decision.note: Feature development can pause. Resume only for real bugs, factual/data corrections, or compatibility/dependency breakage.

strengths: The product is end-to-end complete rather than a visualization demo: people, places, events, relationships, maps, timelines, emperors, chronology, insights, search, details, deep links and offline delivery form a coherent digital-humanities product.
The warm paper, ink, cinnabar and gold visual language is coherent and distinctive; no redesign is justified by the current evidence.
The engineering surface includes sharded data, lazy loading, service-worker/offline behavior, payload budgets, build checks and browser-oriented validation.
README and repository structure provide strong product, architecture and local-build guidance.
The project preserves uncertainty in historical data instead of forcing false precision, which is the correct direction for long-term content quality.

findings.title: Community and release surface is lighter than the core product
evidence: The repository is already usable and publicly presentable, while formal community/release surfaces such as a dedicated security policy, contribution guidance and formal release/versioning are not central to current product operation.
findings.recommendation: Do not reopen active development solely to add repository ceremony. Add these surfaces only when external contribution or formal release needs become real.

findings.title: Tracked standalone artifact is large
evidence: standalone.html is approximately 5.5 MB and is tracked at repository root.
findings.recommendation: Leave the working build/release boundary unchanged unless repository size or artifact management becomes a practical problem.

findings.title: Top-level navigation is dense but not currently broken
evidence: The product exposes twelve major views, creating a dense navigation surface, but the information architecture and README already provide conceptual grouping and the current UI remains coherent.
findings.recommendation: Do not redesign speculatively. Revisit navigation only after concrete usability evidence shows users cannot find or understand major views.

limitations: The GitHub connector exposed the CI workflow definition but did not provide a confirmed green combined status for the audited HEAD, so this audit does not claim that exact HEAD CI was observed passing.

Historical factual accuracy was reviewed as a product-quality concern, not exhaustively verified entity by entity.
recheck_triggers: A real user-facing bug is reported.
A historical fact, date, place, relationship or extraction is shown to be incorrect.
Browser, dependency, GitHub Pages or service-worker changes break existing behavior.
Concrete usability evidence shows the current navigation or information hierarchy is failing users.
The project begins accepting external contributions or formal releases.

reasons: No new publication blocker was identified in this repository review.
The project should continue avoiding committed source-book full text and retain structured/derived-data boundaries.
This recommendation is not legal clearance.

evidence: The project purpose, data scope and exploration model are clearly defined and implemented.
CI defines syntax, tests, build, data invariants, payload and browser-oriented checks; exact audited-HEAD green status was not independently observed.
Static delivery has a relatively small attack surface and workflow permissions are constrained; a dedicated security/community surface is not a current product blocker.
Dependency and workflow surface is comparatively small and controlled, with room for additional provenance hardening if the project resumes active development.
The repository documents a unified build/check path, tests and data architecture.
Online and standalone outputs plus automated validation are mature; formal tagged release/versioning is lighter.
README provides extensive product, architecture, build and navigation documentation.
Data, generators, templates, static delivery and tests are separated and guarded by checks.
The public product is well documented, while formal contribution/security/release community surfaces are comparatively sparse.
